report: We are 2-7 and trail gavinzteam 19.3 to 33.2 this week. Stevenson is questionable, but his matchup is good (DET gives up the 30th-most points to RBs, so he stays in if he plays, with Flournoy ready if he sits). One lineup change: start Omar Cooper Jr. (15.65 average, 19.53 over his last 3, floor 9.88) in place of Jameson Williams, who faces NE (2nd-toughest vs WR, floor 6.58). The weak spots are RB2 (White, 9.74) and the QB floor (Stafford, 9.12). The most important trade to send is Stevenson plus Jameson Williams to Cavery11 for D'Andre Swift (17.09). Send the Shough and Coleman offers next. Swift and Coleman are RB trades, and the Shough offer sends away White, so wait to send it until one of them is accepted.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 15.87 but has dropped to 12.33 over his last 3, and his floor is only 9.12. ARI (2nd-easiest vs QB) helps this week.
Javonte Williams (17.73, 23 carries per game) is a true RB1. White (9.74) and a questionable Stevenson (12.63) make the rest thin.
Higgins (19.98, 28.17 over his last 3) leads. McMillan (15.56) and Cooper (15.65) are solid. J. Williams (13.21) is a good depth piece.
LaPorta averages 11.64 but his last 3 is 5.5 and his floor is 6.78, so he is unreliable.
Flournoy (9.31, 97% snaps) is a steady floor of 6.06 but has no upside. The bench RBs score under 6 per game.
Bench RBs Black (4.71), McGowan (3.63) and Strong (5.5) would not start for anyone. Knight has no stats.

plan: Land a real RB2 (Swift or Coleman) to replace White (9.74) at 17.09 or 12.58.
Upgrade the QB floor to Shough (18.2, floor 14.67) or Allen (25.09, floor 17.8).
Turn the surplus WRs (J. Williams, Dell, Flournoy, McConkey) into starters, and add Lock as a bench QB.

start_sit.why: Cooper averages 15.65 (19.53 last 3, floor 9.88) on 7.67 targets per game against BUF (9th vs WR). Williams has a 6.58 floor against NE, the 2nd-toughest WR defense. Check Cooper's questionable tag before kickoff.

waivers.why: 10.69 avg, 12.3 last 3 beats McGowan's 3.63; snap share data is odd
8.29 avg, 81% snaps beats Shaheed's 6.03 avg, 32% snaps

trades.upgrades: RB2 (replaces White, with a safe RB flex behind)
trades.why: D'Andre Swift averages 17.09 (16.67 last 3, floor 9.44) with 20.33 carries and 72% snaps. That is MORE POINTS and MORE RELIABLE than Stevenson (12.63, questionable). Cavery11 starts Kaleb Johnson (3.31) at RB2 and A.J. Brown (6.37) at WR, so Stevenson fills the RB hole and Williams (13.21) lifts the WR slot by about 6.8.
trades.value_check: 25.8 vs 17.1 (their need makes it worth more)
trades.fallback: Add J. Williams. Walk away if they want Cooper.

Send this only after a RB trade lands, since it costs us White.

That is MORE POINTS from the RB slot, starting after the bye. cash50 starts DJ Moore (9.92) at WR2 and Charbonnet (7.75) at flex, and Dell (13) beats Moore by about 3. Coleman is on cash50's bench and is on a bye this week.

trades.upgrades: QB (replaces Stafford); alternative to the Shough deal, send only one
trades.why: Josh Allen averages 25.09 (floor 17.8) against Stafford's 15.87, which is MORE POINTS. daddyisback8 is 1-8, starts Virgil (2.8) at WR and Fields (7), and has Penix (13.75) behind Allen, so he has a QB backup. Stafford (15.87) beats Penix, and Flournoy and McConkey both start for him. If we use this one, drop the Shough offer.

trades.why: George Kittle averages 14.29 (floor 8.36, 8.33 targets per game) against LaPorta's 11.64 (floor 6.78, 5.5 last 3), which is MORE RELIABLE. Gooner6967 has Goedert (10.57, on a bye) behind Kittle, so he is not left without a TE. LaPorta (90% snaps) starts for him, and McConkey adds WR depth.

McConkey (8.6) and Black (7.0 last week, 10 carries per game) give him depth behind Allgeier (10.08, 12 carries per game), though they are slight upgrades at best.

trades.fallback: Add Black. Walk away at three players.
